subject: [PATCH v3 11/12] nfsd: take the write delegation grant stat before hashing

2026-11-24.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NFSv4 delegation grant process to take a stat of the file before hashing the delegation. This is done by moving the nfs4_delegation_stat function above nfs4_set_delegation and taking the stat just before hashing. The patch also adds an additional stat after hashing to check for changes in the file's attributes. If either stat fails, the delegation grant is declined. This change addresses a potential issue where a client could receive a stale delegation due to a window of time between hashing and the stat being taken.
